exclusions.source_text: Adequate renal function: Serum creatinine \< 2 mg/dL OR calculated creatinine clearance (CrCl) \> 30ml/min
exclusions.threshold: Serum creatinine < 2 mg/dL OR CrCl > 30 ml/min

exclusions.source_text: Pregnant or nursing women are excluded
Previous malignancy other than TCC that, in the opinion of the treating investigator, is likely to interfere with protocol treatment
Individuals with severe renal failure and cannot receive MRI contrast
